description: An amount converted to or from RON at BNR's reference rate, computed exactly and rounded once: to RON is amount x rate / multiplier, from RON amount x multiplier / rate. rate_rule picks the fixing: in_force (the day's, or the last banking day's before it, as rate answers) or last_before (the last one strictly before the day, the rule for an invoice in a foreign currency). Answers the result with the rate, its multiplier and the date BNR published it, so the conversion can be stated. One side must be RON; for two other currencies, convert twice.

amount.description: The amount, as a decimal string: "1250.50", "-75". Never a number.

date.description: The day of the conversion, YYYY-MM-DD in Bucharest (an invoice's date, a payment's); default today.

from.description: The amount's currency: RON, or the currency to convert to RON. ISO 4217; case ignored.

places.description: Digits after the point in the result.

rate_rule.description: in_force: the rate in force on the day; last_before: the last rate published before the day.

rounding.description: How the result is rounded, once: half-up (halves away from zero, as invoices round) or half-even (banker's).

to.description: The currency wanted: RON, or the currency to convert RON to. ISO 4217; case ignored.

name: convert

published_on.description: The date of the fixing the conversion used

rate.description: BNR's exact text, RON per `multiplier` units

result.description: The converted amount, computed exactly and rounded once

title: Convert to or from RON
